procedure.en: Hopper off, grinder running. Turn the top dial clockwise (finer) until the burrs chirp, then back off until they are silent: that is your zero. Start espresso about three whole numbers coarser than zero.
procedure.pt-BR: Sem o reservatório, com o moedor ligado. Gire o dial superior no sentido horário (mais fino) até as mós chiarem, depois volte até ficarem silenciosas: esse é o seu zero. Para espresso, comece cerca de três números inteiros mais grosso que o zero.

notes: Stepless micrometric dial that spins 360° repeatedly; the printed numbers are only a reference, so values are numbers counted from your own zero with 10 numbers per full turn (1+4 = 14, 3.5 = 3.5, 2+3 = 23). Honest Coffee Guide covers about 4 turns for 195–1400 µm, about 300 µm per turn computed; coffeemaster: each half-mark shifts 13 to 33 µm in the espresso zone. Both are particle-size estimates, not burr travel. Specialità and Silenzio share 55 mm burrs; the Manuale has 50 mm burrs, so its numbers will differ. Zero procedure: support.clivecoffee.com/en/eureka-mignon-series-how-to-dial-in-from-the-zero-point.
